changeSet.sql: UPDATE menu_categories c SET active = false, updated_at = NOW() WHERE c.active = true AND c.id IN ( SELECT id FROM ( SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY company_id, store_id, lower(name) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC ) AS rn FROM menu_categories WHERE active = true ) ranked WHERE rn > 1 );
